summary.contract: Collaboration Agreement: Enterprise Singapore and German Entrepreneurship Asia (GIA Innovation Launchpad)
summary.our_entity: German Entrepreneurship Asia Pte Ltd (GEA), UEN 201734553W
summary.role_basis: GEA delivers the Programme and receives the Funding; its name matches the Start2 predecessor entity (assumed).

facts.value: SGD 2,890,000 = Set-Up SGD 700,000 + Programme SGD 2,190,000 (sum checks)
SGD 966,620 (lines sum correctly) against Set-Up cap SGD 700,000: gap SGD 266,620
Two years from signing; Commencement Date 04/11/2019; end date not stated
A, D, E, F are icons only; B and C present; Forms 1a, 1b, GIRO and the FAQ appended. The FAQ forms part of the contract.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No exclusion of indirect or consequential loss and no cap on GEA liability. Exposure is unlimited by default, bounded only by the 12.1 refund of Funding.
findings.action: Insert standard LOL clause. General cap at total Funding paid or payable.

findings.quote: any attempted assignment, subcontract or participation without such consent shall be null and void.
findings.issue: Restriction on subcontracting is mutual, but 6.3(e) to (g) budget for partners, trainers and mentors. Every such engagement is void without ESG consent.
findings.action: Insert the standard carve-out.

findings.quote: for at least 5 years after the expiry of the Project Period and such aforementioned documents may be inspected by ESG or its representatives upon prior written request of not less than 14 days
findings.issue: Audit by an ESG pre-qualified auditor plus 5-year retention and inspection by ESG or "its representatives" on 14 days' notice. No frequency limit, no auditor confidentiality, no facilitation fee, the FAQ (part of the contract) has GEA engage the auditor, so GEA carries the audit cost, which 6.4(d) does not fund. Matches the grant flow-down row, which is accepted as an exception but must be flagged and escalated.
findings.action: Flag internally and escalate. Seek auditor confidentiality and a once-only inspection limit.

findings.quote: GEA shall not disclose to unrelated third parties, either directly or indirectly, any information whatsoever regarding the existence or content of this Agreement without first obtaining ESG's consent.
findings.issue: Confidentiality binds GEA only. ESG has no duty, Start2 methodology and participant information are unprotected, and 8.1 requires GEA to share participant survey information with ESG.
findings.action: Replace with the standard mutual clause including the carve-out for startups sharing information with mentors and potential clients.

findings.quote: Scaler8 Programme.pdf
findings.issue: Annex A (the programme proposal that defines scope under 2.1 and 4(a)) and the Annex D, E and F templates appear only as embedded-file icons. Their content is not in the copy.
findings.action: Obtain and attach the annex files; treat scope as undefined until then.

findings.quote: as per template set out in Annex E ... Survey form in the form set out in Annex F
findings.issue: Module 2 claim documents cite Annex E for the attendance template and Annex F for the survey form. Annex D is the attendance form, Annex E the survey form, and Annex F the progress tracking sheet. Wrong references sit in a payment-release condition.
findings.action: Correct to Annex D (attendance) and Annex E (survey).

findings.quote: GEA shall require Participants to provide the survey form attached in Annex E ... and shall obtain the relevant consents from the Participants to share such information with ESG.
findings.issue: No data protection clause although GEA collects participant, financing, valuation and revenue data in Singapore and Germany and passes it to ESG.
findings.action: Insert clause naming PDPA (Singapore) and the German or EU regime that applies to the Germany activities.

findings.quote: up to a maximum total sum of SGD2,890,000 (the "Funding") (such sum being exclusive of payment of any form of Singapore taxes which are claimable, including but not limited to GST and withholding taxes)
findings.issue: Funding is a ceiling, not a commitment. Tax wording is ambiguous (is GST on top?). No gross-up for withholding. No payment period after a claim is submitted.
findings.action: State GST treatment, add withholding gross-up, define a payment period, and distinguish committed from maximum amounts.

findings.quote: a one-time set-up cost of up to SGD700,000 / Explanation of Down Payment Usage for 1st year of Scaler8 Program SGD 966,620
findings.issue: Annex B projects first-year set-up costs of SGD 966,620 against a Set-Up Cost cap of SGD 700,000. The gap of SGD 266,620 is unfunded or must be recovered through Programme Cost claims, and 6.7 refunds any shortfall in eligible audited cost.
findings.action: Reconcile Annex B to the cap or document who bears the SGD 266,620.

findings.quote: Any indirect costs incurred including but not limited to administration, finance, human resources and support services for information technology.
findings.issue: Annex B includes consultant fees (two lines of SGD 160,000 per year, one for a named person who is also the GEA signatory) and management review meetings. Clause 6.3 lists employed staff salary and specific items; consultant fees are not listed and may be disallowed as indirect or ineligible under 6.4(d), leading to refund under 6.5 to 6.7.
findings.action: Confirm eligibility of each Annex B line in writing with ESG (6.3(j) allows other costs ESG approves in writing).

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No indemnity either way, so no client indemnity for claims caused by participating startups.
findings.action: Insert standard clause.

findings.quote: Except in connection with the performance of the Parties' obligations under this Agreement, no Party shall use the name or logo of the other Party
findings.issue: No IP clause. Start2 methodology, programme materials and deliverable ownership are not addressed.
findings.action: Insert standard IP clause.

findings.clause: Payment terms beyond 30 days / downstream conditions
findings.quote: Upon successful verification by ESG account manager on the achievement of project's deliverables/milestones
findings.issue: No payment deadline. The FAQ page, which forms part of the contract, makes claims conditional on the auditor report and on ESG verification of deliverables, with no time limit.
findings.action: Add a fixed payment period and a deadline for ESG verification.

findings.quote: then the unutilized amount will be set off against the subsequent claims made by GEA of the Programme Cost
findings.issue: No general no-set-off clause. The agreement gives ESG an express set-off against Programme Cost and repayment on demand.
findings.action: Add the standard clause and limit ESG set-off to amounts found ineligible by the Auditor's Report.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No anti-bribery representation. Counterparty is a government agency, where the playbook says push for it.
findings.action: Request once.

findings.quote: ESG shall reimburse GEA in full for all costs incurred by GEA in connection with this Agreement until the effective date of termination.
findings.issue: Covers costs "incurred" only. Costs committed but not yet paid to third parties are not covered. Applies on any termination, which is favourable.
findings.action: Add "committed or paid".

findings.quote: This Collaboration Agreement ("Agreement") is made on 04/11/20019
findings.issue: Preamble date reads 20019. Commencement Date (11.1) and signatures read 04/11/2019. Project Period end date is not stated.
findings.action: Treat as a typographical error; correct in any amendment.

findings.quote: Any dispute between the Parties concerning this Agreement shall be resolved amicably by consultation between the senior management of the Parties.
findings.issue: Singapore law matches the entity. No arbitration seat, tribunal or court forum.
findings.action: Add the SIAC clause.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No entire-agreement or non-reliance clause. The FAQ and the forms are part of the contract but nothing incorporates them.
findings.action: Insert standard clause and list incorporated annexes.

findings.quote: if such suspension continues for more than 3 months either Party may terminate the Agreement with immediate effect
findings.issue: Relieves GEA only. Long-stop is 3 months where the standard is 60 days. No financial-obligation exclusion, mitigation duty or good-faith window. Cost recovery on exit is subject to audit.
findings.action: Align to standard wording.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No interest or right to suspend when ESG pays late. Combined with the missing payment period this leaves GEA with no remedy.
findings.action: Insert, even if the counterparty is a government agency.

findings.quote: At least 60% of Participants agree that "GIA has provided us with useful new networks and opportunities for business or innovation partnerships"
findings.issue: Success metrics (financing over SGD 250,000, valuation up 20%, revenue over SGD 250,000, survey agreement) depend on third parties. They decide renewal at ESG's discretion. No money is clawed back on these metrics.
findings.action: Accept as reporting and renewal criteria; confirm in writing that no refund attaches.

findings.quote: Any revision to the Programme Fees must be mutually agreed upon by both ESG and GEA before communicating to the public.
findings.issue: Participant fees cannot be revised without ESG agreement.
findings.action: Accept; note the limitation for renewal.

findings.quote: may withdraw or cancel all or part of the Funding already disbursed
findings.issue: Refunds are for unutilised Set-Up Cost and on termination for default, net of costs incurred. Tied to eligibility and default, not outcomes. Open-ended wording ("all or part") needs confirmation that it is net of costs.
findings.action: Accept with condition that refunds are net of costs incurred.

findings.quote: "Commencement" shall mean the enrolment by a Participant to a Module and payment of the respective participation fee to GEA
findings.issue: Programme Cost is earned only per enrolled participant who has paid. No minimum, but nothing is paid if enrolment fails. Fixed set-up costs are covered only by Set-Up Cost, which is audited and refundable.
findings.action: Confirm cost recovery on low enrolment; ties to the Annex B shortfall.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No sanctions or export-control clause for a programme running across Singapore and Germany.
findings.action: Insert standard clause.

findings.quote: within the Programme scope and at a reasonable level
findings.issue: Scope is delegated to Annex A (absent) and is open-ended ("reasonable level"). No exclusions stated.
findings.action: State exclusions and attach Annex A.

findings.quote: The Programme will run for a period of two years commencing upon signing the Agreement
findings.issue: No end date and no mechanism for a delayed start.
findings.action: State the end date and a delayed-start rule.

findings.quote: which if remediable, is not remedied within 30 days of a notice given
findings.issue: Cure period is 30 days, not 14. Lacks assignment and reputation triggers. Cost reimbursement in 11.3 is helpful.
findings.action: Accept 30 days if ESG insists; add payment for work performed.

findings.quote: providing in-kind contribution through making available office space, office supplies and other facilities for Participants' use in Germany.
findings.issue: GEA must provide facilities as an in-kind contribution. 6.3(h) funds office expenses, but 6.4(a) and (d) exclude retrofit and indirect cost. The funded boundary is unclear.
findings.action: Clarify whether in-kind items are funded or unfunded.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No performance standard for GEA and no client warranty on information accuracy or authority.
findings.action: Insert standard clause.

findings.quote: Explanation of Down Payment Usage for 1st year of Scaler8 Program
findings.issue: Annex B and the Annex A filename say "Scaler8" while the body says "GIA Innovation Launchpad". Naming differs; confirm no carry-over from another deal.
findings.action: Confirm programme name.

findings.quote: 7.2 For the purposes of this Agreement, "Commencement" shall mean
findings.issue: Two clauses are numbered 7.2. Typos: "competed GIRO form" (7.1), "deemed to be successful at if" (8.3).
findings.action: Correct in any amendment.

findings.quote: Jonathan LIM Director, Global Innovation Network Division
findings.issue: Notice contacts exist; no operational contacts.
findings.action: Request once.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: No e-signature or counterparts clause; signed in wet ink.
findings.action: Add for renewals.

findings.quote: This Agreement is non-exclusive and each Party is free to enter into an agreement with any other party
findings.issue: Affirmatively non-exclusive; favourable.
findings.action: Accept.

findings.quote: Formalised accounting procedures and controls shall be in accordance with Singapore Financial Reporting Standards.
findings.issue: Obligation on GEA to keep SFRS-compliant accounts.
findings.action: Accept.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: Absent. Participants have direct access to GEA mentors.
findings.action: Request once.

findings.quote: will be deemed received on the date they are delivered personally, or five days after mailing if mailed
findings.issue: Per-method deemed receipt present but no postal addresses and no international mail rule.
findings.action: Add addresses.

findings.quote: no Party shall use the name or logo of the other Party for any other purpose, without the prior written consent of the other Party.
findings.issue: Name and logo use is restricted; no case-study right.
findings.action: Request once or accept the restriction.

findings.quote: The Programme will target Singapore-based startups and Singapore-based small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs)
findings.issue: Recital B restates scope detail also in clause 4.
findings.action: Trim or leave.

findings.quote: (clause absent)
findings.issue: Absent.
findings.action: Request once.

findings.quote: All obligations, which by their nature are intended to survive termination, shall survive termination of this Agreement.
findings.issue: Generic survival only. No express list.
findings.action: Add the standard list.

findings.quote: unless sooner terminated by mutual agreement between the Parties
findings.issue: Termination without cause only by mutual agreement.
findings.action: Request once.

findings.quote: a person or entity who is not a party to this Agreement shall have no right under the Contract (Rights of Third Parties) Act
findings.issue: Standard Singapore boilerplate; benign.
findings.action: Accept. Candidate for an optional row in the standard.

PARTIES.note: Both entities, addresses; GEA UEN given. ESG UEN/entity type not stated (statutory board).

RECITALS.note: Recital B restates scope detail (office space, secretarial support, travel) that overlaps clause 4.

SCOPE.note: Scope defined by Annex A, which is not in the copy; no exclusions list; 4(d) "reasonable level" is vague.

TERM.note: Two-year Project Period from signing; no end date stated; no mechanism if programme cannot start on time.

FEE.note: Funding is a ceiling ("up to"); tax wording ambiguous; no gross-up; no payment due date after a claim.

SETOFF.note: Express set-off of unutilised Set-Up Cost against Programme Cost claims; repayment on demand; no general no-set-off.

LATEPAY.note: No payment period, interest or suspension right.

CONF.note: One-way (GEA only); no duty on ESG; no carve-outs; no protection for Start2 methodology.

ASSIGN.note: Mutual restriction present; no carve-out for mentors/experts; attempts are "null and void".

INDCON.note: No partnership, joint venture or agency; no authority to bind.

NOTICES.note: Writing, deemed receipt by method and named contacts with email; no postal addresses; no registered-mail/international split.

AMEND.note: Written variation signed by authorised representatives.

TERM-CAUSE.note: Cure period 30 days (standard 14); no assignment or reputation triggers; 11.3 reimburses costs incurred.

COSTREC.note: Reimburses costs "incurred" only, not "committed"; ESG may also withdraw funding disbursed (net of costs).

WARR.note: No skill-and-care warranty and no client accuracy/authority warranty.

INDEM.note: No indemnity either way; no client indemnity for startup/participant claims.

LOL.note: No exclusion of indirect loss and no cap.

FM.note: Relieves GEA only; long-stop 3 months (standard 60 days); no financial-obligation exclusion, mitigation duty or good-faith window.

IP.note: No IP clause. Only a name-and-logo clause. Methodology and deliverable ownership are silent.

DP.note: No data protection clause although GEA collects and shares participant data with ESG.

DISPUTE.note: Singapore law (matches entity). No arbitration or court forum: only "resolved amicably by consultation between the senior management".

ENTIRE.note: No entire-agreement or non-reliance clause; FAQ and forms are part of the contract but not incorporated.

SURV.note: Generic survival of obligations "by their nature"; no express list.

ESIGN.note: No electronic-signature or counterparts clause (executed in wet ink).

SIGN.note: One signatory per side with designation and date; emails are in 20.1.

ABC.note: Absent. Counterparty is a government agency.

PUBLICITY.note: 15.1 restricts name and logo use; no publicity right.

ESCALATION.note: Named notice contacts, not operational contacts.

1.evidence: Body has no blanks. Claim and GIRO forms are blank by design.

2.evidence: Two clauses numbered 7.2; typos in 7.1 and 8.3.

3.evidence: Preamble 04/11/20019 against 04/11/2019 elsewhere; end date not stated.

7.evidence: No bank details in the agreement; GIRO form blank.

9.evidence: Annex A, D, E, F are icons only; 7.3 cites wrong annex letters (E and F for D and E).

10.evidence: Annex A absent; Annex B names "Scaler8" while the body says GIA Innovation Launchpad.

11.evidence: Two clauses numbered 7.2; Module 2 annex letters wrong.

12.evidence: SGD and Singapore law; no arbitration body stated (see DISPUTE).
